enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Switches the whole addon on or off.

toggleKey.name: Toggle key
toggleKey.description: Starts and stops the bot (not while a screen like chat or inventory is open). You can also use the command /angelbot.

reactionMinMs.name: Reaction time, shortest (ms)
reactionMinMs.description: Shortest wait after a bite before reeling in. The fish only stays on the hook for 1 to 2 seconds.

reactionMaxMs.name: Reaction time, longest (ms)
reactionMaxMs.description: Longest wait after a bite before reeling in. Stay below about 600 ms, especially with a high ping.

recastMinMs.name: Pause before casting, shortest (ms)
recastMinMs.description: Shortest pause between reeling in and the next cast.

recastMaxMs.name: Pause before casting, longest (ms)
recastMaxMs.description: Longest pause between reeling in and the next cast.

timeoutSeconds.name: Timeout without a bite (s)
timeoutSeconds.description: If nothing bites for this long, the rod is reeled in and cast again.

pauseWhileScreenOpen.name: Pause while a screen is open
pauseWhileScreenOpen.description: The bot rests while the chat, the inventory or a menu is open.

stopWithoutRod.name: Stop without a rod
stopWithoutRod.description: Switches the bot off if no fishing rod is held for 10 seconds (for example because you put it away).

switchRods.name: Switch to a spare rod
switchRods.description: When the rod in your hand is used up (see the setting below) or breaks, the bot takes another fishing rod from your hotbar, off hand or inventory and carries on. Without a spare rod it stops. If this is off, the bot stops as soon as the rod is used up.

minRodDurability.name: Rod is used up at (uses left)
minRodDurability.description: A rod with this many uses left or fewer is not used any more, so it does not break (a new rod has 64 uses). 0 = use it until it breaks.

autoEat.name: Eat automatically
autoEat.description: Eats when you are hungry, between two casts. Only while the bot is running. The food has to be in your hotbar, off hand or inventory.

eatBelow.name: Eat at food level
eatBelow.description: The bot eats when your food level is at or below this value (20 = full, every drumstick is 2 points).

foods.name: Allowed food
foods.description: Names of the items the bot may eat, separated by commas, best first. The first one that is found is eaten (off hand, hotbar, then inventory). The default list contains safe, common food and no golden apples.

zoneRadius.name: Allowed area radius (blocks)
zoneRadius.description: The bot stops if you are farther away than this from the center of the area. The center is the point where the bot started or the point you set with /angelbot zone set. 0 = no limit. Walking to another spot needs a radius.

emptyMessages.name: Chat text: spot is empty
emptyMessages.description: If the server shows a message (chat or action bar) containing one of these texts, separated by commas, the bot treats the spot as empty. Upper and lower case do not matter. Messages from players are ignored.

walkToNextSpot.name: Walk to the next spot
walkToNextSpot.description: When the spot is empty, the bot walks to the next saved spot (see /angelbot spot) and fishes there, only inside the allowed area. If this is off, the bot stops. Walking by itself may be forbidden on servers, and it is not tested on every kind of terrain. Stay close at first.

spotCooldownMinutes.name: Empty spot rests for (min)
spotCooldownMinutes.description: A spot that was reported as empty is not visited again for this long.

zoneCenter.name: Area center (x,z)
zoneCenter.description: Set with /angelbot zone set. Empty: the area is centered on the place where the bot starts.

spots.name: Saved spots
spots.description: Saved with /angelbot spot add. Format: x,y,z,yaw,pitch, several spots separated by semicolons. You can also clear or edit the list here.

biteThreshold.name: Bite threshold
biteThreshold.description: How fast the bobber has to sink to count as a bite, in hundredths of a block per tick. Lower means more sensitive. Default: 15.

settleTicks.name: Settle time (ticks)
settleTicks.description: How long the bobber has to float before bites are detected (20 ticks = 1 second). Prevents false bites right after casting.

debug.name: Debug output
debug.description: Reports in chat and in the game log (latest.log) when the bobber almost reaches the bite threshold. Helps to tune the sensitivity.

debug.bite: [Angelbot] Bite detected (sink speed %s), reacting in %s ticks

messages.started: Started. Keep a fishing rod in your hand.
messages.addonDisabled: The addon is switched off in the settings.
messages.notPermitted: This server has not allowed the Angelbot. It needs the "angelbot" permission (LabyMod Server API): the server can enable it, or you can switch it on yourself in the LabyMod settings under server features, at your own risk.
messages.notInGame: You have to be in a world first.
messages.noRod: Hold a fishing rod in your main hand or off hand.
messages.paused: Paused: a screen is open. Tip: F3+P stops Minecraft from pausing when the window loses focus.
messages.rodSwitched: Switched to another rod (%s uses left).
messages.noFood: You are hungry, but none of the allowed food was found.
messages.walking: The spot is empty. Walking to spot %s of %s.

stopped.leftGame: Stopped: you left the world. Bites: %s
stopped.noRod: Stopped: no fishing rod in hand. Bites: %s
stopped.noSpareRod: Stopped: the rod is used up and there is no spare rod. Bites: %s
stopped.noWater: Stopped: the bobber does not land in water. Bites: %s
stopped.noResponse: Stopped: the server does not react to the rod. Bites: %s
stopped.outOfZone: Stopped: you are outside the allowed area. Bites: %s
stopped.spotEmpty: Stopped: the spot is empty and the bot cannot walk to another one. Bites: %s
stopped.allSpotsEmpty: Stopped: all saved spots are empty or resting. Bites: %s
stopped.walkFailed: Stopped: the way to the next spot is blocked or the bot got stuck. Bites: %s
stopped.walkDanger: Stopped walking: damage, water or low health. Bites: %s
stopped.addonDisabled: Stopped: the addon was switched off. Bites: %s
stopped.notPermitted: Stopped: this server does not allow the Angelbot. Bites: %s
stopped.error: Stopped because of an internal error (see latest.log). Bites: %s

messages.statusOff: The bot is off. Start it with /angelbot or the toggle key.

spot.added: Spot %s saved at %s / %s / %s (with your viewing direction).
spot.none: No spots saved yet. Stand where you want to fish, look at the water and use /angelbot spot add.
spot.notFound: There is no spot with that number.
spot.notOnGround: Stand still on the ground first, then save the spot.
spot.notWalkable: Note: the bot cannot stand safely here (slab, stairs, carpet, water, lava or cactus nearby), so it will not walk to this spot.
spot.full: The list is full (%s spots). Remove one first.
spot.outside: This place is more than %s blocks away from the center of the allowed area.

zone.setNoRadius: The area has no radius yet. Set "Allowed area radius" in the addon settings, otherwise there is no limit.
zone.cleared: Area center removed. The area is centered on the point where the bot starts.
zone.showNone: No fixed center: the area is centered on the point where the bot starts (radius %s blocks, 0 = no limit).
